description: Official central bank policy interest rates as JSON, no API key: Federal Reserve (target range + EFFR), ECB (deposit, MRO, MLF; all 21 euro countries), Bank of England, Bank of Canada, Riksbank, Danmarks Nationalbank, Norges Bank, Banco Central do Brasil, Central Bank of Iceland. Latest rate with last change date, hike/cut, 1-year change, decision history, recent decisions across banks, compare. Monitor mode returns only new rate decisions. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €9/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.02/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/central-bank-rates-api.

country.description: ISO codes of the bank's country: US, EA (euro area), GB, CA, SE, DK, NO, BR, IS. Euro member codes (DE, FR, IT, ES, ...) and names like Germany return the ECB row. UK and full names work. Empty = all banks. Required for history.

days.description: For decisions: how many days back to list rate changes (1-9000, default 365).

endDate.description: For history: last date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today.

limit.description: Maximum rows for history (newest kept). Between 1 and 20000.

mode.description: latest = current rate of each bank with effective date, previous rate, hike/cut and 1-year change; history = every rate change of one or more banks (needs Country); decisions = all rate changes across banks in the last N days, newest first;

rate.description: policy (default, each bank's headline rate). ECB also: deposit, mro, mlf. Denmark also: lending, current-account, discount. US also: effective (daily effective federal funds rate, history only).

sort.description: For latest: country (default), rate (lowest first), rate_desc, recent (latest change first).

startDate.description: For history: first date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default = full history.

name: central_bank_rates_api
title: Central Bank Rates API - Policy Interest Rates, Official Data
